applicability.scope: Comparing stage, device-mesh and operator-sharding candidates for static distributed training when heterogeneous stage memory or work, or communication cost, makes a uniform data/tensor/pipeline plan suspect; derived from historical Alpa, not a current compiler configuration guide
applicability.prerequisites: The packaged source notes are read; the skill authorizes no compiler or solver install or run, parallelism reconfiguration, repository edit, hardware task or benchmark
applicability.input_contract: Model operator graph and shapes; global batch, microbatch and accumulation; precision and optimizer; physical links and contention; candidate shard layouts; stage latency, workspace and in-flight activation memory; the objective and expected run length. A device count without topology is insufficient
applicability.produced_artifact: The best supported candidate and a simpler fallback with a memory and critical-path ledger, planning cost and amortization, semantic invariants, counter-signals, missing evidence and a proposed matched comparison; a plan, not a reconfiguration
failure_modes: Equal arithmetic work is taken to mean equal kernel time, carrying over Alpa's zero compute-cost simplification
Mean memory replaces the largest per-rank peak with multiple in-flight activation sets
Inter-stage transfer and microbatch count stay outside the objective, as in historical Alpa, without the gap being reported
Repeated slow-link sends to replicated destination tiles are not compared with one cross-mesh transfer plus local allgather
Inter-node Network traffic is merged with intra-node accelerator links
Static cost estimates are applied to dynamic shapes, asymmetric devices or changing communication contention
applicability.refusal_point: Rejects infeasible stage/mesh pairs, claims no global optimality outside the declared search space, and stops at the plan in paper-only mode

recommendations: Keep a simple reference plan with the same training semantics and global batch as the comparison point.
Separate fixed-model scaling from model-size weak scaling before quoting a speedup; Alpa's 9.7x MoE ratio belongs to a specific weak-scaling workload, baseline and 25-Gbps cluster.
Weigh planning cost against the expected run length; a shorter job may not amortize it.
limitations: Source-derived candidate; no local efficacy validation.
Original typed source inventory is not normalized; retain source identities and limits in the procedure/readsets.
